thread:
sam: Noticed a ~15% throughput drop on marketplace image push when nodes are on driver 535 + CUDA 12.2, affecting batched inference throughput. Saw it on two SI customer environments.
li: Interesting — is latency spiky or steady lower throughput?
sam: Latency p95 is similar, but overall tokens/sec drops for large-batch workloads. Repro steps: synthetic batch of 64, seq_len 1024, measured tokens/s before/after driver bump.
priya: Which image tag did the SI use? marketplace or custom?
sam: marketplace/redwood:d-2026-03-20 (we rolled marketplace pipeline last night). SI had automated update -> pulled latest and reported.
igor: Any logs or perf counters? cuBLAS/cuDNN calls look heavier?
sam: Perf traces show increased cuBLAS GEMM stall time and higher kernel launch latency. No OOMs. Attaching short perf snippet in the ticket.
marketplace-bot: deployment completed to prod-marketplace, tag redwood/d-2026-03-20 by priya (auto-roll).
priya: OK, putting an emergency hold on auto-rolls for NV driver stacks while we triage.
si-partner: FYI — our managed cluster updated overnight and customers noticed throughput hit. We're getting a support queue. Need ETA and mitigation.
li: Short-term mitigation: republish marketplace image pinned to driver 532 (we tested earlier and throughput matches baseline). Also add a note to partner integrators to postpone driver upgrades.
igor: Can we run a quick A/B on a subset of nodes (pin 532 image) to confirm?
sam: Spinning up A/B now: 3 nodes pinned to 532 vs 3 nodes on 535. Will run the synthetic batch.
priya: Also loop in NVIDIA for kernel-level changes in 535 that could affect batched GEMM. @nvidia-eng please triage.
nvidia-eng: Thanks. We'll look into GEMM scheduling and possible heuristic changes in 535. Please share perf traces and the minimal repro. Also confirm CUDA version across nodes.
si-partner: Repro attached to our ticket. This impacts inference throughput but not correctness. Our customers want a rollback ASAP.
marketplace-bot: action: hold set on driver-auto-roll pipeline by priya.
li: A/B results: pinned 532 matches baseline tokens/sec, 535 is ~14% lower. No memory pressure difference.
igor: Good data. Next: marketplace should publish a pinned tag (d-2026-03-20-pin-532) and update release notes. Notify SI partners to pull that tag.
priya: I'll publish pin and coordinate a short partner message. Draft: "We've identified a performance regression associated with NVIDIA driver 535/CUDA12.2 on batched workloads. We recommend using redwood/d-2026-03-20-pin-532 until we resolve with NVIDIA. Hosted customers unaffected." Thoughts?
si-partner: Please include rollback commands for managed clusters and a contact for escalations.
li: Add kubectl snippet and helm upgrade example in the partner note. Also include how to verify tokens/sec after rollback.
nvidia-eng: We're triaging on our side. If you can provide raw kernel timelines and cuBLAS version strings it will help. We may have a dispatch change in 535 that's suboptimal for certain batch shapes.
sam: Uploaded kernel timelines + cuBLAS/cuDNN versions to the ticket.
priya: Publishing pinned tag now and bumping marketplace docs. ETA 15m.
marketplace-bot: published redwood/d-2026-03-20-pin-532, tag pushed.
si-partner: Pulling pinned image now and validating in staging. Will report back within 30m.
li: Action items recap: 1) marketplace: push pinned image + hold auto-roll (priya). 2) infra/ops: provide rollback snippets for partners (li). 3) eng-ml: minimal repro and perf traces to NVIDIA (sam/igor). 4) partnerships: send partner comms + escalation contact (priya).
priya: Sending partner comms now. Include support@redwood.ai and phone on-call for high-priority customers.
si-partner: Confirmed tokens/sec back to normal on pinned image. Thanks.
nvidia-eng: We've reproduced perf delta in our lab; driver team investigating a scheduling heuristic. Will update when we have a fix or recommended driver pin.
li: Keep this thread updated. We'll keep the auto-roll hold until NVIDIA gives guidance.
sam: Thanks everyone — saved a bunch of customer headaches. Will attach validation logs to the SI ticket. :thumbsup:
